name: sslsniff
summary: A tool to MITM all SSL connections on a LAN and dynamically generate certs for the domains that are being accessed on the fly
highlights: -a — Authority mode. Specify a certificate that will act as a CA.
-t — Targeted mode. Specify a directory full of certificates to target.
-c — File containing CA cert/key (authority mode) or directory containing a collection of certs
-s — Port to listen on for SSL interception.
-u — Loction of any Firefox XML update files.
-f — Only intercept requests from the specified browser(s).
